name: John Hancock
fact: President of the Continental Congress; signed his name largest, famously so 'King George can read it without his spectacles.'

name: Benjamin Franklin
fact: Oldest signer at 70; also signed the Treaty of Paris and the Constitution.

name: John Adams
fact: Became the second President of the United States.

name: Thomas Jefferson
fact: Principal author of the Declaration; became the third President.

name: Samuel Adams
fact: Organized the Boston Tea Party; cousin of John Adams.

name: Roger Sherman
fact: Only person to sign all four founding documents: the Declaration, Articles of Association, Articles of Confederation, and the Constitution.

name: Elbridge Gerry
fact: Later Vice President under Madison; namesake of 'gerrymandering.'

name: Richard Henry Lee
fact: Introduced the resolution calling for independence on June 7, 1776.

name: George Wythe
fact: First American law professor; mentor to Thomas Jefferson.

name: Caesar Rodney
fact: Rode all night through a thunderstorm to cast Delaware's deciding vote for independence.

name: Button Gwinnett
fact: Died in a duel in 1777; his signature is among the rarest and most valuable in history.

name: Lyman Hall
fact: A physician who later became Governor of Georgia.

name: William Whipple
fact: A former sea captain and slave trader who later freed his own slave.
